title: rubus franchetianus
intro: Rubus franchetianus, commonly known as Himalayan Raspberry or Tibetan Raspberry, is a species of raspberry native to the Himalayas and Tibet. It is a medicinal plant with various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Rubus franchetianus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, which can help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Rubus franchetianus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
